intro: Discover the transformative power of Yin Yoga with our comprehensive 50 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training Course in Bali. This unique practice is designed for everyone—from those seeking relaxation and stress relief to fitness enthusiasts and athletes looking to enhance flexibility and prevent injuries. Yin Yoga can also be characterized by long holding of the positions which focus on the deep layers of the body including the ligaments, fascia, and tendons.

Stress is a part of today’s life – it can be a tough training session, hours at a desk, or standing at work. Yin Yoga is helpful in this, especially in the areas where people are usually stiff—hips, chest, lower back, and legs. While other forms of yoga work on muscles, Yin Yoga affects the tendons and ligaments of the body. More specifically, one can use bolsters, blocks and blankets in order to practice without pain and injuries. This Yin Yoga Teacher Training in Bali will provide you with the information to teach Yin Yoga or deepen your practice.

Yin Yoga has its origin from China and is based on the Taoist principles of Yin and Yang. It concentrates on the fascial system which includes ligaments, tendons, and fascia by holding the postures for 3-5 minutes or more to address the deeper tissues of the body as well as the psyche.
